title: ImageNet preprocessing confound quantification
inference: none for B1-1 to B1-3; B1-4 reuses the A2 K=20 dumps

protocols.P_exact: timm official eval preprocessing (resize shorter side to 256, center crop 224; crop_pct 0.875); runs imagenet_mnv2_{050,100}_exact_k3
protocols.P_cf: crop-free preprocessing (geometry_mode squash to 224x224); runs imagenet_mnv2_{050,100}_crop_free_k3
protocols.P_exact_EA: P_exact inputs; z computed only from controls whose effective area is within +-5 % of the target's (B1-4, after A2)

populations.primary: all 10,000 samples of each pair (every sample is scored in both runs)
populations.secondary: samples whose clean prediction is correct in both runs of the pair

b1_1_area.cell_area: Per target cell and protocol: effective fraction = effective_area_px / 50176 over the 10,000 samples (mean, p5, p50, p95, min, max) and its ratio to the nominal 1/16. Target areas must be identical across the three operators and both models (asserted). cell_type: corner r0c0,r0c3,r3c0,r3c3; center r1c1,r1c2,r2c1,r2c2; edge the rest.
b1_1_area.within_sample_ratio: Per sample and protocol: max over cells / min over cells of effective area (distribution), next to the analytic square-image value 4096 / 2304 = 1.78 for P_exact.

control_area.item_level: control item effective area / its target's effective area (same sample, target region from region_params_json), over every control item and condition
control_area.anchor_level: ratio of anchor-mean areas as ssat.analysis.indexer computes it (control anchor area = rounded mean over all its items); per target anchor, the share whose K control anchors are all within tolerance. At 0.05 this must reproduce the stored area_matched flag exactly.

b1_2_ranking.profile: metrics/spatial_profile.parquet margin_drop per (sample, cell): mean over every target item of that sample and cell
dataset_level: Spearman between the two runs' 16-cell mean profiles
top-region share per cell (share of samples whose largest-margin_drop cell is that cell; ties by region_key ascending, as in P0-2) and its difference
sample_level: per-sample Spearman over the 16 cells (samples with a constant profile in either run are excluded and counted): median, IQR, p10, p90, share < 0.5
top-3 overlap |A intersect B| / 3 (ties by region_key ascending)
b1_2_ranking.cell_level: per cell: mean rank in each run (rank 1 = largest margin_drop within the sample), mean rank change, and Spearman across the 16 cells between the cell's effective-area ratio (P_cf / P_exact mean effective area) and (a) its mean rank change, (b) its grade change rate

b1_3_grade.source: stored reliability.parquet of both runs (A1 parity-checked)
metrics: agreement, linear weighted kappa, unchanged / 1-step / >=2-step shares, up / down
change decomposition: grade changed with sign_consistent changed; grade changed with only exceeds_control changed; other
all of the above per cell type (corner / edge / center)
b1_3_grade.control_matching_context: stored area_matched TRUE share per protocol (anchor level)

b1_4_effective_area_controls.status: runs after the A2 K=20 exact and crop-free dumps exist; definition fixed here before those dumps are produced
b1_4_effective_area_controls.population: the A2 2,000-sample subset (salt rev1-a2, 2 samples per class)
b1_4_effective_area_controls.eligibility: a control item is eligible if |effective_area(control item) / effective_area(target) - 1| <= 0.05
b1_4_effective_area_controls.z: per (target anchor, condition): control anchors with at least one eligible item contribute the mean of their eligible items; z = (target - mean) / std (ddof 0) over those control anchors if there are at least 3, otherwise UNAVAILABLE
b1_4_effective_area_controls.grade: A1 grade engine with default thresholds
compare: (a) P_exact, control_index 0-2 of the K=20 run
b1_4_effective_area_controls.report: grade distributions, pairwise agreement / weighted kappa, eligible-control count distribution and UNAVAILABLE share per cell type

representative_cases.rule: mnv2_050: the samples whose per-sample exact-vs-crop-free Spearman is closest to the p10, p50, and p90 of its distribution; ties broken by sample_id ascending
representative_cases.panels: original image, exact heatmap, crop-free heatmap, per-cell effective area under each protocol

correction_neutrality: No protocol is treated as the correct one; P_exact, P_cf, and P_exact_EA are all reported (experiment plan section 5.6).
subsets: none for B1-1 to B1-3; B1-4 uses the A2 subset
